keyword: how many back to back winners of the masters
claims: As of the conclusion of the 2026 Masters, four golfers have won back-to-back Masters titles.
Rory McIlroy won the Masters in 2025 and 2026.
Jack Nicklaus won the Masters in 1965 and 1966.
Nick Faldo won the Masters in 1989 and 1990.
Tiger Woods won the Masters in 2001 and 2002.
No player has won three consecutive Masters tournaments.
